_source: github.com/uwm-bigdata/DFUTissueSegNet — index masks, order confirmed by inspecting two masks against their photographs
_licence: NO LICENCE FILE in the repository; the README asks only for citation. Absence of a licence is not a grant of permission — confirm terms with the authors before using it.
_warning: The released annotations carry FOUR values, not the eight tissue categories the README lists. There is NO necrosis or eschar class: dark necrotic tissue sits in class 0 with true background. A model trained on this alone learns that necrosis is background.
_unmapped: callus is not a class of this model and falls to background
